title: Super Sweet Submissive ASMR (ORIGINAL)
description: A hypnosis file for those with a bit of a praise kink. This one is all about giving your brain a little vacation and break. There's no pressure with this trance. No explicit expectations other than your submissive enjoyment of falling deeply under, with my whispers slowly pulling away your thoughts. Making me so happy by listening so sweetly, and so intently. My voice is here for you... Comforting, with the affection that feels so very good. Affirming, because you deserve to be encouraged to be happy. Blissful, to calmly wash away your thoughts. In life there are leaders, like me, and those who follow, like you. So all I ask is for you to relax and try to follow my softly spoken cadence. As once I have you hanging on my every word, it is so very easy to tip the scales, and snap away your mind. Until all that is left is one ... single ... trigger. That one ... single ... word. DROP
author: Mistress Shibby
